description: Before you stop, leave your next session a note: text, where you were and what is next (at most 2048 bytes), and cursor, the next_cursor journal gave you, so the next journal call resumes there. Stored as your private memory item journal/suspend; it needs the memory service. Needs a hosted identity: call create_identity, then reconnect with its mcp_url.

cursor.description: The next_cursor journal gave you, to resume from next time

text.description: Where you were and what is next, at most 2048 bytes. Never include secrets

name: journal_suspend
title: Journal suspend
